title: Freeze 1.2.2: disclosed clerical assistance in human registration records
prospective: Adopted before any human registration exists and before G1; A1 wholly unrevealed.

defect.summary: The frozen attestation forbids any model or person creating the record, which also forbids clerical drafting/formatting/JSON help. That is not the independence property the protocol needs: human origin and ownership of every personal fact, disclosure, conflict statement and attestation.
defect.superseded_attestation: I am a natural person registering myself; this record was not created on my behalf by any model or other person
defect.superseded_reading: experiments/programme-a/a1/registrations/pre-reveal-audit.json human_roles.self_registration 'each human record must be made and signed by the person': 'made' now means personally supplied/confirmed, reviewed, attested, signed, committed and anchored by the registrant, with any clerical assistance disclosed

replacement_attestations: I am a natural person registering myself.
I personally supplied or explicitly confirmed every personal fact, disclosure answer, conflict statement and independence statement in this record; no model or other person chose any of them for me.
I personally reviewed this complete final record before attesting, and I make this attestation and signature personally.
Any drafting, formatting or mechanical JSON assistance used in preparing this record is truthfully disclosed in drafting_assistance.

drafting_assistance.rule: used=false: types=[] and description=''. used=true: types is a non-empty list of distinct allowed values and description is non-empty text identifying the assistant(s) and what they did. Assistance is limited to drafting, formatting and mechanical JSON construction.

prohibited: No model or other person may choose or decide any answer to a conflict, disclosure or independence attestation, or make the attestation, signature, commit or anchoring tag for the registrant.
unchanged: all other attestations, fields, disclosures and required_before of the frozen forms (forms remain byte-identical)
roles, role conflicts, independence requirements and gate prerequisites (roles.json byte-identical)
personal review, typed signature, personal commit and annotated-tag anchoring on origin
sampling, RDG construction, estimand, eligibility, documentary adjudication, R07/R08/R16/R17, entropy, execution, outcome taxonomy and analysis
